sloka: शोभमानम् असम्बाधम् तम् राज पथम् उत्तमम् ।सम्व्Rतम् विविधैः पण्यैः भक्ष्यैः उच्च अवचैः अपि ॥२-१७-५॥
transliteration: śobhamānam asambādham tam rāja patham uttamam ।samvRtam vividhaiḥ paṇyaiḥ bhakṣyaiḥ ucca avacaiḥ api ॥2-17-5॥

translations.english: The highway (Rama entered) was splendid and spacious with heaps of sandal and agaru of the highest quality, excellent fragrant substances and bundles of white silken cloth. It gleamed with unholed (pristine) pearls, articles made of crystals, flowers of every kind and articles of food of every variety.
translations.hindi: भेरा हित चाहने वाले गुरु, पिता ओर कृतज्ञ महाराज मुके. जो आज्ञा दें उनकी प्रसन्नता के लिए ऐसा कौन काम है, जिसे मैं निःशाङ्क हो न करूँ ?
